description: Gate-guard Skyhawk in the memorial grove at the former NAS South Weymouth - now the Union Point trail network - at 42.16451 -70.94605. Baugher: preserved on the gate at NAS South Weymouth 1 September 1989 after service with VMA-311 and NARTU South Weymouth. An OSM way tagged A-4 Skyhawk ref 2970 sits on it in the current extract.
